[Story]
Xiaohua's sister recently buys a new computer, she worries that others damage the computer, she never allows others to use it.\nToday, a new game comes out, Xiaohua wants to play the game on the new computer. When Xiaohua's friend asks him if he wants to play the new game, Xiaohua says he does not.

[Question]
Why does Xiaohua want to play the new game, but he says he does not?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Because he actually does not know how to play computer games very well.
B. Because she does not have the time and equipment to play the new game.
C. Because he fears that his sister gets angry if he uses her new computer to play games.
D. Because he does not want his friends to know he cannot play the new game.
